name: Sunrise Vinyasa Flow — All Levels Welcome
descriptionText: Join us for a free sunrise vinyasa class in the park. Bring your own mat. All levels welcome, no experience necessary. Coffee and tea after class.

name: Tuesday Night Run Club — 5K Social Run
descriptionText: Easy-paced 5K social run followed by drinks at the trailhead bar. New runners always welcome, no watch required.

name: Gallery Opening: New Works on Paper
descriptionText: Opening reception for our new exhibition of works on paper by local artists. Wine and light bites provided.

name: Downtown Food Truck Friday
descriptionText: Weekly food truck gathering in the plaza with live acoustic music. Family friendly, free admission.

name: Intro to Pottery Wheel Workshop
descriptionText: Hands-on beginner pottery wheel workshop. All materials included, no experience necessary. Limited to 10 seats.

name: Open Mic Comedy Night
descriptionText: Weekly open mic comedy night. Sign up at the door, 5 minute sets. Two drink minimum.

name: Neighborhood Book Club: Fiction Pick of the Month
descriptionText: Monthly book club discussion. This month's pick is a contemporary fiction novel. New members welcome.

name: Rooftop Salsa Social
descriptionText: Weekly salsa social with a short beginner lesson followed by open dancing. No partner necessary.

name: Farmers Market Volunteer Morning
descriptionText: Volunteer shift helping set up and run the weekly farmers market. Coffee provided for volunteers.

name: Startup Founders Happy Hour (Local Chapter)
descriptionText: Monthly happy hour for local startup founders across all industries — not conference-affiliated, just our regular neighborhood meetup.

name: Board Game Night
descriptionText: Weekly board game night, bring a game or play one of ours. Snacks and drinks available for purchase.

name: Photography Walk: Golden Hour Downtown
descriptionText: Casual photo walk around downtown during golden hour. Bring any camera, phones welcome. Beginners encouraged.
